en.headline: Observatory issues Thunderstorm Warning until 11:45am
en.dek: Isolated thunderstorms were expected over New Territories East, Hong Kong Island and Kowloon after the warning was issued at 9:50am on Monday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 9:50am on Monday, 14 September, saying it would remain effective until 11:45am. Isolated thunderstorms were expected over New Territories East, Hong Kong Island and Kowloon.

A local weather bulletin issued at 10:02am recorded 29 degrees Celsius and 82 per cent relative humidity at the Observatory. Between 8:45am and 9:45am, rainfall of up to 17 millimetres was recorded in Kwun Tong, with up to 14 millimetres in the Eastern District and up to 9 millimetres in Sai Kung.

The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek safe shelter, leave the water and avoid outdoor swimming or other water sports, and keep away from high ground, trees, masts and other conductive objects. A later forecast issued at 10:45am called for sunny intervals and a few showers, isolated thunderstorms at first, and hot conditions during the day, with light to moderate easterly winds.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 有效至上午11時45分
zh.dek: 天文台周一上午9時50分發出雷暴警告，預料新界東部、香港島及九龍有局部地區雷暴，警告有效至上午11時45分。
body: 香港天文台周一（9月14日）上午9時50分發出雷暴警告，有效時間至同日上午11時45分，預料新界東部、香港島及九龍有局部地區雷暴。
天文台上午10時02分的天氣稿顯示，天文台錄得氣溫29度、相對濕度82%。上午8時45分至9時45分期間，觀塘錄得最多17毫米雨量，東區最多14毫米，西貢最多9毫米。
天文台呼籲身處室外的市民到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿在戶外游泳或進行其他戶外水上運動，亦勿站立於高地或接近導電物體、樹木或标杆。其後上午10時45分發表的預報指，今日大致多雲有陽光及幾陣驟雨，初時有局部地區雷暴，日間炎熱，吹和緩東風。
